title: The push-skip decision and script text say child repos follow @stable, not "pin by SHA"
why: Coordinator 03:32 CST Nov 14 (relayed from the degen #706 lane's hand-in; the lane says R44 and the stable test say @stable; triage read the two texts below on the stable checkout, not R44's @stable wording or the test): docs/decisions/push-skip-on-proven-tree.md line 7 says child repos "pin it by SHA"; actions/push-skip/push-skip.py line 4 says "Child repos pin the action" and line 20 says a repo "that pins this action by SHA gets the reader its pin carries". Widened 03:37 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:35, from the lane of PR #3394, draft, head 7cc41cdf7, text-only; the lane's read, triage read the lines on the stable checkout 15e8899): more places say SHA pinning: actions/push-skip/action.yml:15 ("a pin by SHA carries its own readers"), lint/test_push_skip.py:4 ("Child repos pin that action"), skills/ci-hygiene/SKILL.md (the shared-action pin text near :268; line numbers moved from the lane's :330) and skills/ci-hygiene/snippets.md:152 and :359 (`@<full-sha>`). Triage read: R44 part 1 (restart-plan R44 item 1, owner 14:05 CST Nov 11 "A build all 3": child CI runs claude-settings actions from the stable branch, not a commit pin) is the ruling; docs/plans/r42-part2-design.md P7 already flags the skill SHA rule as failing it. BUT no child repo or workflow on main uses @stable yet (grep of the stable checkout: only plan text), and design step 6 (child repos on @stable) is unbuilt, so a text-only PR that says child repos follow @stable would state something false today. Wording rule for the lane: say what is true now (child repos still pin by SHA until the switch) and the ruled direction (R44 part 1: @stable), or hold the PR until the switch lands. Two more finds 03:50 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:49, from the #3394 round 1; triage read both lines on the stable checkout): GLOSSARY.md:29 (term "stable branch") says "Target, not live: no `stable` branch is on origin yet" while origin/stable exists (triage read the remote branch list on the stable checkout, commit 15e8899); lint/test_push_skip.py:5 says "Until the lift moves the script, the copy at .github/scripts/push-skip.py answers" (the lane says the test asserts that path absent; triage did not read the assertion). Both are stale text of the same family; the lane takes them if it fits its PR, else a sibling text-only step.
